caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet displayed from three different angles: front, side, and back. The bonnet features a wide, dark navy or black band with a subtle striped pattern, which appears to be made of velvet or silk, forming the frame and long ribbons that hang down. The main section of the bonnet is adorned with intricate, light-colored lace, highlighted with shining beads, pearls, and glittering accents. The left side is decorated with two large, purple fabric flowers, while the right side displays a cluster of delicate, feathery brown and gold embellishments. The side view shows the same elements layered, including the purple flowers, lace, and beaded decorations, while the rear view focuses on the bonnet’s soft, padded inner lining in a pale shade, revealing how the decorative elements wrap around the exterior edges. All three views are rendered on a neutral, cream-colored background.
title: Bonnet
